// files: Figma file keys, from the URL: figma.com/design/<FILE_KEY>/... 'default' is the design-system library. 'screens' is the product file when your org splits them. 'volatile' lists keys that get republished wholesale, so their node ids renumber — never trust a written-down id for those.
// auth: Where the Figma personal access token comes from. The env var wins; envFile is the fallback. NEVER commit the token — add the envFile to .gitignore.
// design: The frame your mocks are drawn on, plus the widths and theme modes you verify against.
// paths: Where generated artifacts land, relative to the project root.
// tokens.index: Modules the extractor indexes so it can suggest a code reference for a value it finds in Figma. 'exports' can be a list (the export name is the reference prefix) or a map of exportName -> reference prefix. 'nested' indexes inside a per-mode wrapper: themes.light.components is referenced in code as components.*

tokens.// spacing: Most design systems do NOT bind Figma variables to gap/padding, so the ramp is code-owned and the extractor checks values against it. Set tokenizedInFigma:true if yours DOES bind them — verify by extracting a component and seeing whether gap comes back ✓bound.
tokens.// typography: The generated text ramp and how text is written in code. forbiddenProps are the props your project refuses to let anyone hand-set on DS text (with the reason the agent is shown). Start this empty and add entries only when you hit a real rendering reason.

typography.forbiddenReason: These come from the generated ramp — hand-setting them silently drifts from the design system.

// components: The code side of the design system. The agent scans 'index' before building anything, so reuse beats reinvention. 'instanceMap' translates a Figma instance name to your component when the names differ.
// icons: extraNamedColors are the named colors Figma emits that must become currentColor (hex is always handled). rtlMirrored lists icons that flip under RTL — a UX decision, not something to auto-detect.
// text: Noise filtering for copy extraction. Add your locale's Figma placeholder words and any currency/number formats that are not translatable copy.
// variables: How the Figma variables export maps onto generated files. 'sources' matches exported filenames to a role — one 'primitives' entry plus one 'mode:<name>' per theme mode. 'groups' routes each top-level group in the export to a destination. Run the export once and look at the filenames + top-level keys to fill this in.
// typographySource: Figma TEXT STYLES are not variables, so they are fetched from the API separately. Prefixes match your style-naming convention ('<prefix><Category>/<Weight>'). The FIRST prefix is the base — it drives metrics and faces. Add more only when a second style tree's faces diverge from the base (a second locale, say): those contribute face OVERRIDES only. faceFixes corrects known Figma authoring bugs on export, loudly.
// commands: Your project's real commands. config-check.js verifies these resolve, and the skill tells the agent to run them.
// gotchas: Per-library incidents worth remembering — a misnamed component, a hole in a token set, a variant axis your code deliberately ignores. Starts empty; add one line per surprise instead of re-deriving it next quarter.
